prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: original transparent torn-paper header artwork for Lights Landing Coffee website, also the master for matching section borders.
Primary request: one very long horizontal strip of real pale eggshell/light-yellow paper torn by hand along BOTH long edges, photographed perfectly flat from directly above under diffuse soft overhead light. Original artwork from scratch, no reference or stock image.
Composition/framing: wide 3:1 canvas, preferably 2400x800. One continuous paper strip extends fully off both the left and right image boundaries: DO NOT show the short ends. The strip occupies the central 40 percent of the canvas height, about 300px of an 800px-tall image, with generous genuine transparent space above and below. Both long edges are fully visible. No props, no text, no mockup, no labels.
Color palette: the body is warm pale eggshell, a very light yellow-ivory around RGB 243,237,217 (#F3EDD9). It must read as warm creamy yellow paper, NOT neutral grey. Centre is evenly pale and suitable for dark brown navigation text, with gentle texture only. Torn exposed core is a warmer creamy white.
Materials/textures: tactile laid paper with fine vertical ribbing that fades in and out, cloudy pulp flocs, short embedded fibres, gentle mottling, slightly uneven illumination. Each long torn edge has an irregular, natural, wide creamy-white rolled lip: broad in some places and barely present where the tear is cleaner. Surface layer pulls back to reveal fibrous core curling slightly upward. A few soft pale grey-beige creases wander and fade irregularly inside the lip, NOT continuous parallel ribbons. Long gentle wander combined with sharp small jags, with modest tear depth. The outer fringe has tiny pale translucent paper fibres plus an occasional longer strand, fine fuzz not eyelashes. Both edges have different unique tear patterns, no repeat or tiling.
Lighting: restrained relief shading within the paper only, softly lit from overhead. Shadows stay very pale warm paper-grey. No dark creases, no black, no foil or metallic appearance. No cast shadow below or around paper; the website adds its own shadow.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha outside the strip, including between the fine fibres. Straight-on flat scan look, no perspective. No background plane, no wood, no checkerboard drawn into the image. Keep the inner middle half of the paper strip fully solid and uniformly bright.
Avoid: neutral grey paper, cool colour cast, brown kraft paper, deckle-cut waves, repeated serrations, ruler-straight tears, parallel stripe-like ridges, evenly spaced hairs, outer drop shadows, text, logos, watermark.
user_direction: Use warm eggshell/light yellow instead of the brief's neutral grey.
